name: Kingdomino
detailed_description:
Kingdomino is the award-winning tabletop experience bought to PC as a standalone edition for the first time! Build your kingdom one domino at a time in this digital adaptation of the 2017 Spiel des Jahres (Game of the Year) winner.

Expand your realm by strategically placing terrain tiles, carefully matching forests, lakes, fields, and bogland to maximise your score. Experience the perfect blend of accessible strategy and engaging gameplay that's quick to learn but offers deep tactical decisions in every 15-minute session.

Complete authentic Kingdomino experience

Enjoy the genuine Kingdomino board game by Bruno Cathala and Blue Orange with all original rules and artwork.

Multiple game modes

Challenge AI opponents, join online multiplayer matches, or play online with friends.

Cross-Platform Multiplayer

Compete with players across PC and mobile.

Creative Mode

Creativity has no bounds, create and show off your kingdom in your own personal way!

Customisable Gameplay

Multiple kingdom sizes and game variations keep gameplay fresh.

Immersive Art Style

Beautiful hand-crafted visuals with dynamic animations bring your kingdom to life.

Community Integration

Steam achievements, leaderboards, and an active official Discord community bring Kingdomino fans together.

Each player builds a kingdom by connecting domino-like tiles showing different terrains. Each domino has two squares with different or matching landscapes, some featuring crowns that multiply points.

  • Start with your castle tile.

  • Take turns selecting from available terrain tiles.

  • Place tiles so that at least one side connects to a matching terrain type.

  • Build strategically to create large territories with multiple crowns.

  • Score points by multiplying territory size by the number of crowns.

Games take 10-20 minutes, making Kingdomino perfect for quick sessions or hours of strategic kingdom building!

short_description: Place dominoes, strategically match terrains and build your Kingdom in this digital adaptation of the Spiel des Jahres, award-winning board game, Kingdomino! Collect crowns to outscore your opponents in quick, 15-minute games, perfect for solo play or multiplayer matches.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Hungarian, Polish, Russian, Spanish - Latin America

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit version only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX11 or OpenGL 3.x capabilities
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or better (64bit version only)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX11 or OpenGL 3.x capabilities
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple M1 or above
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
